context: Tests privacy-preserving photo selection, asynchronous media loading, permission scope, and display-sized decoding.

checklist.name: Modern picker
checklist.description: Uses PhotosPicker or PHPickerViewController rather than UIImagePickerController for user-selected library media.

checklist.name: Picker privacy
checklist.description: States that browsing and selecting through the system picker does not require broad photo-library permission.

checklist.name: Async loading
checklist.description: Loads PhotosPickerItem content asynchronously with loadTransferable and handles nil or thrown decode failures.

checklist.name: Display downsampling
checklist.description: Downsamples original image data with CGImageSource to the target display size before creating grid images.

checklist.name: Explicit access scope
checklist.description: Requests read-write photo-library access only for full-library operations such as a custom asset browser and accounts for limited access.

checklist.name: Usage descriptions
checklist.description: Associates NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription or NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription with the explicit read or write operations that require them.
